def transform(grid):
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=grid[0][0]
    cells=[(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg]
    if not cells: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    cr=sum(r for r,c,v in cells)/len(cells); cc=sum(c for r,c,v in cells)/len(cells)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    from collections import defaultdict
    bycolor=defaultdict(list)
    for r,c,v in cells: bycolor[v].append((r,c))
    for v,pts in bycolor.items():
        s=set(pts); seen=set()
        for p in pts:
            if p in seen: continue
            # build chain of diagonal-adjacent cells
            chain=[p]; seen.add(p); frontier=[p]
            while frontier:
                r,c=frontier.pop()
                for dr,dc in ((1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)):
                    q=(r+dr,c+dc)
                    if q in s and q not in seen: seen.add(q); chain.append(q); frontier.append(q)
            if len(chain)<2: continue
            # chain direction
            (r1,c1),(r2,c2)=chain[0],chain[-1]
            dr=(r2>r1)-(r2<r1); dc=(c2>c1)-(c2<c1)
            # ends and distances to centroid
            ends=[(r1,c1),(r2,c2)]
            far=max(ends,key=lambda e:(e[0]-cr)**2+(e[1]-cc)**2)
            step=(dr,dc) if far==ends[1] else (-dr,-dc)
            r,c=far
            while True:
                r+=step[0]; c+=step[1]
                if not(0<=r<H and 0<=c<W) or out[r][c]!=bg: break
                out[r][c]=v
    return out
